title: Juice N Power Watermelon Gummies Shortfill E-Liquid
description: A beguilingly subtle yet sweet and refreshing eliquid from Juice N Power, this is an exotic blend of watermelon given a moreish candy sweetness from gummies. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks.
